ETL pipeline (Phase 1):

1) scripts/01_ingest.R reads raw-data/ CSV/JSON and manually generated tables into RDS bundles.
2) scripts/02_transform.R harmonizes into a canonical schema and writes data/derived/*.csv.
3) scripts/03_validate.R runs basic checks and writes data/derived/validation_report.md.

Render the site after ETL:

```bash
R -q -e 'renv::restore()'
R -q -e 'source("scripts/01_ingest.R"); source("scripts/02_transform.R"); source("scripts/03_validate.R")'
quarto render
```

For publishing with GitHub Pages, configure the repository to serve the docs/ directory from the main branch.
